about_the_game:
⚠️ Language Notice

 

This game is currently available in Japanese only. An English translation is not available at this time.

 

~ On the night of the full moon, the detectives confront the phantom thief ~

 

One day, Alf, a boy who helps out at his family’s restaurant, is visited by his childhood friend, Charlotte — a young detective.

 

Alf: “Oh, Charlotte — I didn’t notice you come in. Have you decided what to order?”

Charlotte: “Hehehe... I was waiting for you to finish up! My order is... a brilliant assistant!”

 

The mysterious phantom thief “Phantom Thief Oblutaire” continues to elude capture, leaving the kingdom abuzz with rumors.

To follow his trail, the two set out on a new adventure beneath the moonlight.

 

🔍 About the Game

Detective Looks at the Moon is a detective RPG where you gather clues, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind each case.

As you progress through the story, you will take on puzzles and reasoning challenges, engage in strategic turn-based battles, and complete side quests.

By cooking dishes, Charlotte may even gain new skills that help her in combat.

 

🧩 Game Features

■ Collect “clues” throughout the main story to unravel the mysteries hidden behind each incident.

■ Solve ciphers and puzzles to reveal secret bosses, and grow stronger by defeating them.

■ Help townspeople through side quests to earn powerful items.

■ A unique growth system where Charlotte gains new skills inspired by food she eats.

■ Strategic turn-based battles where elemental affinity and equipment choices are key to victory.

■ Guilds, requests, cooking, and powerful bosses — aim for the highest Detective Rank!

 

💬 Developer’s Note

This game began as a personal hobby project, and over the course of five years, it has been carefully crafted with love and attention to detail.

I truly hope you enjoy the world, characters, and mysteries within.

 

📺 Streaming & Video Guidelines

Gameplay streaming, commentary, and video uploads are welcome.

There are a few guidelines regarding story puzzles and spoilers, which are explained in detail on the Community Hub.

If you plan to stream or upload videos of the game, I would appreciate it if you could take a moment to review them.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: On the night of the full moon, a young man becomes assistant to his childhood friend, a detective. They take on guild quests, solve mysteries, and chase the phantom thief “Obrutale,” a figure both feared and admired. A mystery RPG full of story, battles, and secrets.
